reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: deleteMember is exported and called from MemberManagementClient.tsx:680. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions defined; entry point is an authenticated admin action (not a trusted-source bypass). Gate 3: src/lib/actions/members.ts is explicitly in scope. Spec deviation is real — L524-527 only issues UPDATE members SET deleted_at = now() with no corresponding DELETE/UPDATE on member_team_relations, violating the post-condition forall m: post(softDelete(m)) => !exists(member_team_relations, m.id). Attack path is latent: exploitation requires a future query or new feature reading member_team_relations without filtering through deleted_at IS NULL; no existing route currently exposes stale rows to an attacker, making the path uncertain rather than concrete.
